description: This file defines the HomeActivity class for an Android weather app, managing the main UI, user interactions (search, voice input), location services, network requests for weather data, and app update handling.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: Main activity handling weather display, user interactions, location retrieval, network requests, and app updates.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets event listeners, checks for app updates, and fetches initial weather data.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles results from voice recognition activity, updating the city input and triggering search.

methods.name: setNavigationBarColor
methods.description: Sets the navigation bar color for API level >= Lollipop.

methods.name: setUpDaysRecyclerView
methods.description: Configures the RecyclerView for daily weather forecasts.

methods.name: listeners
methods.description: Sets up user interaction listeners for UI components such as search, refresh, and voice input.

methods.name: setRefreshLayoutColor
methods.description: Customizes color schemes for the refresh layout.

methods.name: searchCity
methods.description: Performs city search, checking internet connectivity and updating location data.

methods.name: getDataUsingNetwork
methods.description: Obtains location data via GPS or permissions and fetches weather info accordingly.

methods.name: setLatitudeLongitudeUsingCity
methods.description: Fetches geographic coordinates for a given city name and initiates weather data retrieval.

methods.name: getTodayWeatherInfo
methods.description: Fetches current weather and daily forecast data from the server.

methods.name: updateUI
methods.description: Updates UI components with fetched weather data.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Translates day names to localized versions.

methods.name: hideProgressBar
methods.description: Hides the loading indicator and shows main layout.

methods.name: hideMainLayout
methods.description: Displays the progress indicator and hides the main layout.

methods.name: checkConnection
methods.description: Checks for internet connectivity and refreshes weather data if connected.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles runtime permission responses for location access.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Checks internet connection when activity resumes.

methods.name: checkUpdate
methods.description: Checks for and initiates immediate app updates if available.
